  • Frames 7 and 8 shipped as the judges charged them in every round: grey cylinder tubes and a petri tower that reads as pancakes. The kit now carries the replacements for the next lab deck.

1. The post copy

Which of 630,003 protein pairs inside mitochondria actually meet?

Texas A&M scientists in College Station recast Google DeepMind's AlphaFold-Multimer as a yes or no test on pairs of mitochondrial proteins. Texas A&M High Performance Research Computing supplied the computing. The screen kept 2,895 of 630,003 pairs as likely, the paper's 0.46%. 57% of the 2,895 were in none of the databases checked. Lab work guided by the predictions defines copper's route to cytochrome c oxidase.

Mutations in nearly 30% of mitochondrial proteins are tied to human disease. The method can't say how tightly a pair binds. The release says cures may still be far off.

All 2,895 predictions are free online as MitoMatch, at mitomatch.web.app. The set carries an apparent false discovery rate of 15%. Which pairs are the false ones?

#CollegeStation #TAMU #AlphaFold

Notes

Carousel no. 72 is Texas A&M's AlphaFold-Multimer screen of 630,003 mitochondrial protein pairs, 2,895 kept, free at mitomatch.web.app. It shipped at the round cap at 7.266 after three ladder rounds and one hard-fail repair round. Two hard fails were found and repaired, both the university release overstating the paper. The web edition dated AlphaFold-Multimer to 2022 on the release's word (round 2); no year is carried now. Slide 7 said the 85 proteins got their "first" partners (round 3); it now uses the paper's own "at least one predicted partner". The record: 92 due items re-verified or re-measured, League City's Prop A result, ERCOT's November 5th audit update, tx-2026-0244 admitted with 11 primary claims. For a maintainer, outside this run's lane: prompt_audit.py counts agent spawn delays as waits on a human (repeat 7), and fetch_doc still passes a host whose robots.txt blocks ClaudeBot site wide (no. 71 lost 30 claims to it). Both are in UPGRADE_BACKLOG.md. Prompt audit, final reading: 2,207 tool calls measured, 105 counted as waiting. The longest are Agent spawns at up to 17.6 s; the slowest Bash call waited 2.3 s. No call has the shape of a human answering a dialog; this is the escalated latency count above. No-stall hook: armed at 2026-11-09T05:03:36Z. At session start it judged the session unattended (CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0), and the host's CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED was 0. It judged the session unattended from 2026-11-09T05:03:36Z and refused nothing.
